review.official:
Podenco is an operator who applied to join
Rhodes Island
through a normal process, and is responsible for taking care of the greenhouse and cultivating flowers in
Perfumer's
Convalescent Garden. Can also be deployed as a combat operator and is capable of utilizing her understanding of plants to heal teammates or disrupt enemies.

files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Podenco has no signs of Originium infections. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.13u/L
Operator Podenco has very little contact with Originium. 

'That scent, it's so good... So refreshing... Ah, ah... Achoo!' —A medic operator with a pollen allergy

Podenco was born into a small settlement on the steppes near the border of Bolívar. While this remote settlement was able to escape the flames of war due to its distance from the center of Bolívar, this isolation also created its own problems. To ensure their survival, the people of this settlement delved into their natural talents at evading Catastrophes and cultivating crops. Podenco has been interested in a variety of plants since a young age, likes to make dried flowers, and also tended a small nursery back home. As she grew up, she became involved in the community's farming efforts, gaining rich experience in botanical cultivation for plants both edible and ornamental. When asked which type of plants she prefers, Podenco will quietly tell you that she likes flowers more, but when food and clothing become a scarcity, she will silently stash away her personal preferences deep into her heart.

Not everyone who lives in these remote regions aspires to lead a bustling life in a distant land, but Podenco was one such person who did. The people of her home had little contact with the outside world, but the interactions they did have gradually gave Podenco a rosy impression of the outside world, particularly towards flowers. She had seen all kinds of flora in the world depicted through books and photos, but someone who never left Bolívar would never be able to see these flowers in their entire life. Within her stirred a great anticipation to see the outside world.

After arriving at Rhodes Island, her becoming Perfumer's coworker and apprentice was actually by chance. The young Podenco, like a fledgling leaving the nest, was completely spellbound by the magnificence of the city after arriving at the closest nomadic city from her hometown. She couldn't wait to find some place filled with fragrance and beauty, and soon after, she bumped into Perfumer in the middle of the street. Perfumer immediately noticed Podenco's fondness for flowers, and her own Garden happened to be short of the personnel needed to make her aromatherapy raw materials. And just like that, Podenco ran into someone by mistake, and landed herself the first job of her life. 
Compared to Perfumer, Podenco still is lacking in many ways. Her sense of smell isn't as sensitive as Perfumer's, nor does she have any knowledge of auxiliary professions, but she is quickly approaching Perfumer's skill with the momentum she has. From a single flower, to a garden, and now to an entire greenhouse, Podenco has the skill to independently manage the Convalescent Garden. In addition, she also began to use the flowers she collected to create a wide variety of reagents, constantly adapting to meet the demands of the various medics in the medical facility. In time, she may well become the world's undisputed master of horticulture. 
And it all stems from her love for flowers. 
A lifelong love.

'Podenco's Greenhouse - Production Commission Details' 
We can make floral tea, which is best enjoyed in the greenhouse. 
With a flower purse, you can always carry a soothing fragrance with you. 
Experience better rest with a flower pillow (please allow extra time for production). 
Come enjoy my flower biscuits, but please supply all the ingredients other than the flowers. 
Please discuss with me if you would like to request any other items, and I will see if there is a possibility of making it. 
There are many combinations of the above items to choose from. Please contact me for further details.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: Hm… Hmm… Hmmm… Oh, Doctor, is your day going well?

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: This is a floral tea that I made myself, Doctor. Come try a cup, I promise you'll feel cozy all day.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: The sunlight in the greenhouse is so comfy. Even if I'm in charge here, it sometimes makes me want to sit down and relax for a bit.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Use the fruits of your labor to make everyone forget their sorrows and worries. That's probably a gardener's primary objective, don't you think?

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: I much prefer gardening to fighting. But as long as I think about how I'm helping everyone, I can muster up the courage to go into combat.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: These bottles? They're the pollen and seeds I've been collecting. I usually put on a gas mask and gloves before handling them, to protect me from poison.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: Hm, everyone seems a bit weary these days. But, when they see the flowers I've planted, I'm sure they'll cheer right up.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Doctor, Doctor! Are you coming to the greenhouse today? Everyone's been awfully busy the last few days… If nobody comes by the greenhouse, they're going to miss the blooming season. And wouldn't that be a terrible shame?

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Tending the greenhouse is really hard. But, as long as the flowers I grow can make people smile, all my hard work will be worth it!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: Doctor? Oh, you're asleep… May the flowery fragrance waft over your dreams.

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: Doctor, it's Podenco, here to say hi! If you have time, I'd love for you to come by the greenhouse!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: Oh… I was expecting a video about gardening.

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Artist? N-N-No, I'm not that talented. I'm just a normal gardener.

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: Look, Doctor! These are the new varieties I've been tending for so long. They've finally started to bloom! Aren't they gorgeous?

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: Hm? Am I going too?

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Um, I've only ever tended a greenhouse. Can I really help with this…?

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: I see the enemy! Let's go!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: Everybody, look after yourselves!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Yes?

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Where are we going?

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: Got it.

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: I'll do it.

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: Careful, this pollen is allergenic.

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: Okay, I'll handle this.

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: I've seen weeds like these before.

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Let me protect everyone!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Phew, are we safe already? Good job, everyone!

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: Achieving a flawless victory is like cultivating a beautiful flower. Both require a lot of hard work.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Doctor, everyone is waiting for your next orders.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Ah… I never thought it would turn out like this…

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Should we plant some flowers over here?

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Oh, Doctor?

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Doctor! Would you like to decorate your office with some flowers?

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Back home, most flowers would already have withered by now. But just thinking about how spring will be here soon… fills my heart with hope. Doctor, let's find the first flower that blooms in the greenhouse together!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Hello, Doctor!

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! Please, try this floral tea! I made it the way Miss Lena taught me, and if you really savor it, you can taste a hint of cake flavor! Eh? You can't? Let me try… Oh… Sorry, Doctor. I… I think I forgot the honey…

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: I've been all over with Rhodes Island. Does that mean I've spread flowery fragrance to just as many places? Hehe… I may still have lots of room for improvement, compared to Miss Lena, but I'll do my best to make Rhodes Island an even warmer place!
